The `blowhorn platforms` commands. Each one's `--help` prints the same text.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`platforms capabilities`](#blowhorn-platforms-capabilities) | Show what each platform allows: text limits and counting, media, tagging, actions and published rates, with the provenance of every fact and the tier overrides a profile's account unlocks. |

## blowhorn platforms capabilities

Show what each platform allows: text limits and counting, media, tagging, actions and published rates, with the provenance of every fact and the tier overrides a profile's account unlocks. A fact with no value is not on record and is never enforced. `--platform` reads one platform; `--stale` keeps only the platforms with a fact past its review date.

```text
blowhorn platforms capabilities [OPTIONS]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | boolean | `false` | Emit machine-readable JSON output |
| `--platform` | string |  | Platform scope for `blowhorn platforms`. One of: bluesky, facebook, github, hn, instagram, linkedin, reddit, slack, tiktok, x, youtube, all (`all` means every platform listed here) |
| `--stale` | boolean | `false` | Keep only the platforms with a fact past their review date |
| `--pace` | string |  | Accepted by `blowhorn platforms capabilities` because `--pace` is a global flag, but this command does no paced work -- it sleeps between nothing -- so the value changes nothing about how it runs and appears only in the Pace column of the -v summary. Resolved as CLI flag, then `BLOWHORN_PACE`, then defaults.pace in .blowhorn.yaml (normal when none is set); an unrecognized value is rejected before anything runs |
| `--risk-profile` | string |  | Accepted by `blowhorn platforms capabilities` because `--risk-profile` is a global flag, but this command does no gated work -- no Risk Profile hold, cap or pace applies to it -- so the value changes nothing about how it runs. A value after the command word wins over one before it; an unrecognized value is rejected before anything runs |

Also takes the [shared flags](/docs/reference/cli/shared-flags/): `--config`, `--log-dir`, `--profile`, `--exclude`, `--headless`, `--chrome-launch`, `--headed`, `--dry-run`, `--verbose`.

Examples:

```bash
blowhorn platforms capabilities
blowhorn platforms capabilities --platform x --json
blowhorn platforms capabilities --stale
```

Output: json with `--json`, text otherwise.
